updates.content:
Title: Users may be seeing unexpected users when changing accounts in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

User impact: Users may be seeing unexpected users when changing accounts in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

More info: Affected user are unable to modify or access these unexpected users in any way.

Current status: We've reviewed recent changes to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and identified an update that correlates with the time this issue began. We're considering our options to revert it back to a healthy build to remediate impact.

Scope of impact: Users attempting to change account in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat may see unexpected users.

Root cause: A recently deployed build of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat contains an issue that's showing unexpected users when changing accounts in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.

Next update by: Friday, October 23, 2026, at 12:30 AM UTC
